mapper.select: SELECT item_id , name , description , category , cost_point , stock , is_active AS active , created_at FROM `SHOP_ITEM` WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY cost_point ASC, item_id ASC
SELECT item_id , name , description , category , cost_point , stock , is_active AS active , created_at FROM `SHOP_ITEM` ORDER BY is_active DESC, cost_point ASC, item_id ASC
SELECT item_id , name , description , category , cost_point , stock , is_active AS active , created_at FROM `SHOP_ITEM` WHERE item_id = #{itemId}
SELECT item_id , name , description , category , cost_point , stock , is_active AS active , created_at FROM `SHOP_ITEM` WHERE item_id = #{itemId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE `SHOP_ITEM` SET stock = stock - 1 WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND stock IS NOT NULL AND stock > 0
mapper.select: SELECT c.coupon_id , c.item_id , i.name AS item_name , i.category , c.coupon_code , c.cost_point , c.status , c.purchased_at FROM `USER_COUPON` c JOIN `SHOP_ITEM` i ON i.item_id = c.item_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.purchased_at DESC, c.coupon_id DESC
